description_expanded: A Lil Beach House – 30A Gulf-Front Gem About A Lil Beach House: This property is currently undergoing a major renovation with over $250,000 being invested into upgrades and improvements and will be available for guests to enjoy once the work is complete. These enhancements are designed to elevate the overall experience while maintaining the relaxed coastal charm that makes this area so special. Located in Santa Rosa Beach, the home sits in one of the most desirable areas along Florida’s scenic 30A corridor. Guests will be just minutes from the sugar-white sand beaches and emerald waters that have made the Emerald Coast famous. The home's private beach access makes it easy to spend your days relaxing by the Gulf, swimming in clear water, or enjoying sunset walks along the shoreline. The location also offers convenient access to the vibrant communities along 30A, known for their boutique shopping, beachside cafés, and locally loved restaurants. Scenic bike paths run throughout the area, allowing visitors to explore the coastline at a relaxed pace while taking in the natural beauty and charm of the surrounding beach towns. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate being close to the region’s rare coastal dune lakes and nearby state parks, where visitors can enjoy paddleboarding, kayaking, hiking trails, and stunning Gulf views. With beaches, dining, shopping, and outdoor adventure all just minutes away, this location provides the perfect base for experiencing everything Santa Rosa Beach and the 30A area have to offer.
